coaching.title: Easy 6mi Z2 + Strength
coaching.message: Today is a relaxed aerobic 6 miles in Zone 2, HR 138–150 bpm — if you can't hold a conversation, back off. Pair it with strength session 2 (eccentric + plyometric durability and core); those downhill-ready legs are exactly what the Julian Alps' 2500m of descending will demand. We're 36 days out, sliding into the taper, so resist the urge to push. Easy today keeps you fresh for the sharpening ahead.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: It's short, so no heavy pre-load needed — a light carb snack 60–90 min out is plenty. Given the strength work, prioritize the post-session window: 25–35g protein plus carbs within 45 min to drive repair and adaptation. Keep total carbs around your rest-day-plus range (~250g) since load is light, and hydrate well — Vegas heat compounds fluid loss even on an easy effort.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: The strength session is the real stimulus today, so protect it: 10 min of mobility on hips, ankles and thoracic spine post-lift, and foam roll quads and calves tonight. Aim for 8+ hours of sleep — as we enter taper, recovery quality is what converts months of training into race fitness. No junk miles, no ego reps.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: Taper brain is coming — that itch to prove fitness with one more hard session. Reframe it: the work is banked. The next five weeks are about arriving at Kranjska Gora sharp, not tired. Every easy run and every honest strength rep is a deposit toward the summit of that first big Julian Alps climb. Trust the plan.
